articles.title: Londoner Grand Secures ‘Best Hotel – Macao’ Award for Second Consecutive Year at TTG Travel Awards
articles.rawDate: Sep.25 Londoner Grand Secures ‘Best Hotel – Macao’ Award for Second Consecutive Year at TTG Travel Awards
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 25, 2026) – Londoner Grand has once again been awarded “Best Hotel - Macao” at the TTG Travel Awards for its consistent delivery of distinctive guest experiences. Organised annually by TTG Asia, the 2026 winners are the top Asia-Pacific travel sector performers as voted by readers of TTG Travel Trade Publishing’s major publications.

articles.title: Michelin Keys 2026 Recognises Three of Sands China's Esteemed Properties as Among the Best Globally
articles.rawDate: Sep.24 Michelin Keys 2026 Recognises Three of Sands China's Esteemed Properties as Among the Best Globally
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 24, 2026) – Three Sands China properties secured Michelin Keys in the 2026 selection. For the second consecutive year, The Londoner Hotel, Four Seasons Hotel Macao, and The St. Regis Macao have all been awarded One Key.

articles.title: ‘Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme for Rua das Estalagens 2026’ Unveils 24 Selected Enterprises
articles.rawDate: Sep.23 ‘Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme for Rua das Estalagens 2026’ Unveils 24 Selected Enterprises
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 23, 2026) – An award presentation ceremony at The Londoner Macao announced and recognised 24 enterprises selected for Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme for Rua das Estalagens 2026. The programme comprises the Entrepreneurship Recruitment Programme 2.0 and a newly introduced Shop Rebranding Programme.

articles.title: Celebrating Two Michelin Keys for Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong
articles.summary: Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong has been elevated from One Michelin Key to Two Michelin Keys in the Michelin Guide’s 2026 hotel selection, marking a significant milestone just one year after the Michelin Key distinction was first introduced in Hong Kong.

articles.title: Sands China Leads Macao Awardees with Most Restaurants Recognised on Trip.Gourmet's 2027 Fine Dining List
articles.rawDate: Sep.19 Sands China Leads Macao Awardees with Most Restaurants Recognised on Trip.Gourmet's 2027 Fine Dining List
articles.summary: (Macao, September 19, 2026) – Six Sands China restaurants earned ratings on Trip.Gourmet’s 2027 Fine Dining List, giving the company the most awardees in Macao under one roof. The Huaiyang Garden received Black Diamond; La Chine received Diamond; and Gordon Ramsay Pub & Grill, Jiang Nan by Jereme Leung, Zi Yat Heen, and The Manor received Platinum.
